title: salix cordata var. angustata
intro: Salix cordata var. angustata, commonly known as River Birch, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Salix cordata var. angustata include reducing pain, inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include salicin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
